By Subject

If you know the subject specialist in your area, you may schedule an appointment. Please feel free to contact your Subject Librarian directly, ask for assistance at a Library Services Desk, email library@buffalo.edu or chat with a librarian for additional assistance. We look forward to hearing from you.
